items.context: @FrankAFetter (21.145 seguidores), en inglés: «Bottom 3% quantile on the 200-week moving average. At $59k, the asymmetry is to the upside. $BTC» (con gráfico). Cuenta mediana con post despegando: ~1 h 50 min, 5.669 vistas, 188 likes, 22 guardados, 17 reposts y solo 10 respuestas. Menciona la media de 200 semanas, que es uno de los cuatro componentes del índice Market Temperature.
items.suggested_text:
Part of why the 200-week average works as a floor signal is that it's slow: about 3.8 years of weekly closes, close to a full halving cycle. Being in its bottom 3% quantile means price is cheap against almost the entire last cycle, not just against last month.

It's one of the four inputs in the Market Temperature index I track, alongside MVRV, drawdown from the record and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, 25% each. That reading went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days, about as cold as the model gets.

Still, asymmetry describes the odds, not the timing. After the late-2013 top the drawdown reached -84.5% and the old high took 1,177 days to come back. Cold can stay cold longer than it feels.
